hook: Humble (謙) and empty (虚) of pride: a modest person.
Where it was first (原) produced (産): its place of origin.
Origin (原) plus beginning (始): the very first, primeval times.
Strict (厳) and heavy (重): very strict, severe security.
Humble (謙) and yielding (遜): you lower yourself and play down your skills.
Prefecture (県) plus government office (庁): the prefectural office.
Limit (限) plus degree (度): the furthest degree you can go, the limit.
現 means present, appear: it is present right now, so actually, really.
Origin (原) plus logic (理): the basic logic at the root, a principle.
Original (原) materials (料): the raw stuff before you make anything.
恋 is romantic love: you love and miss someone dear.
Factory work (工) plus member (員): a member of the factory staff.
Strong (強) pull (引): pulling people your way by force, pushy.
Craft (工) plus art (芸): beautiful things made by skilled hands.
Filial piety (孝) put into action (行): being good to your parents.
Words from the mouth (口) dressed up as truth (実): an excuse.
Public (公) crowd (衆): everyone, the general public, like a 公衆電話.
Fragrant (香) water (水): perfume.
Merit (功) plus results (績): the good things you achieved.
Light (光) in a line (線): a light beam.
High (高) layers (層) of floors: a high rise building.
Build (構) plus make (造): how something is built, its structure.
Exchange (交) and replace (替): workers take turns and swap shifts.
Plowed (耕) land (地): land you can farm.
Agree (肯) and fix (定) it: say yes, affirm.
High (高) degree (度): altitude, or a high, advanced level.
High (高) grade (等): high class, advanced level.
Join (合) into the same (同) group: combined, joint.
High grade (高等) school (学校): senior high school, short form 高校.
Make it public (公) and show (表) it: an official announcement.
Ore (鉱) thing (物): a mineral dug from the ground.
Clause (項) plus item (目): one item on a list.
Join (合) flows (流): two rivers or groups merge.
Effect (効) plus power (力): how strongly something works.
焦 is scorch (fire dots at the bottom): you burn the toast.
Country (国) plus king (王): the king of a country.
Set up (立) by the country (国): national, like a national university.
Polite ご + hardship (苦) + labor (労) + 様: thanks for your hard work.
焦 is scorch (fire dots below): the food gets burnt.
凍 means freeze (ice radical): you are freezing cold.
Something hits (当たり) your heart (心): you have an idea who or what it is.
Get (得る) it in your heart (心): understand it well.
Hang (掛け) your hips (腰) on it: a seat or bench.
Hang (掛) your hips (腰) on it: a seat, same as 腰掛け.
Hang (掛ける) your hips (腰) on something: sit down.
Fifty (五十) sounds (音): the kana chart, about 50 sounds.
Individual (個) body (体): one single individual living thing.
Old (古) classic texts (典): the classics.
Attach (付ける) words (言) for someone: leave a message.
Polite 御 + no (無) news (沙汰): sorry I have not been in touch.
堪 means endure: hold back tears and bear it.
Amusement (娯) plus fun (楽): entertainment, recreation.
Honorable (御) look (覧): polite please look, as in ご覧ください.
転 means turn or roll over: you roll a ball.
転 means turn or roll over: the ball rolls on its own.
Thread (糸) dyed deep: navy blue cloth, like old indigo work clothes.
Mix (混) and join (合): a mixture.
Dishes offered (献) and set up (立) in order: the menu.
Be in (在) study (学): enrolled at school now.
Again (再) and three (三) times: again and again.
Festival (祭) day (日): a national holiday.
Urge (催) and push (促): press someone to pay or act.
Pick out (採) points (点): mark tests and give scores.
Disaster (災) plus difficulty (難): bad luck, a calamity.
Cut cloth (裁) and sew (縫): sewing.
Material (材) from trees (木): lumber, timber.
逆 means reverse: upside down, the wrong way round.
Reverse (逆) state (様): upside down.
捜 is search with your hand (扌): look for something lost, like police searching.
遡 means go upstream: go back up the river of time.
Alcohol (酒) place (場): a bar.
一昨日 is two days ago; add one more before (昨): three days ago.
A little extent (程) before (先) now: a while ago.
Search (索) and pull (引) out: the index at the back of a book.
Shave off (削) and remove (除): delete.
Make (作) plus manufacture (製): produce, make.
A mouth (口) next to three ears (耳): whisper.
匕 inside 匙 is an old spoon shape: a spoon.
A room to sit (座) on spread out (敷) tatami: a tatami room.
Something stuck in (差し) that blocks (支え) things: a hindrance, a problem.
Insert (差し) and pull out (引き): add and subtract, what is left is the balance.
Pierced (刺) flesh (身): raw fish slices.
Special reading: flowing (流) stone (石); think stones stay solid in a river, as expected.
Take a photo (撮) of the image (影): photographing, filming.
Mixed (雑) sound (音): noise.
Early (早) and fast (速): right away.
錆 has the metal radical (金): metal goes rusty.
妨 means obstruct: get in the way, prevent.
騒 has a horse (馬): horses making a noisy fuss.
Produce (産) land (地): where something is grown or made.
Mountain (山) woods (林): mountain forest.
Work done (仕) rises up (上がる) to the end: it is finished.
明後日 is the day after tomorrow; add one more 明: three days from now.
Temple (寺) plus institution (院): a temple.
Self (自) defense (衛): self defense.
Salt (塩) plus spicy, sharp (辛): very salty.
Salt (塩) plus sharp taste (辛い): salty.
Run (司) the meeting (会): host or chairperson.
There is no (ない) way of doing (仕方) it: it can't be helped.
Time (時間) divided (割) up: a timetable.
Land (地) laid out (敷): the site of a building.
敷 means spread: lay out a futon on the floor.
茂 has the grass radical (艹): plants grow thick.
Hold (持) and go (参): bring it with you.
Magnetic (磁) stone (石): a magnet.
Throw away (捨) four (四), put in (入) five (五): rounding numbers.
Start (始) to end (終): from beginning to end, always.
Learn (習) by yourself (自): self study.
静 means quiet: things become quiet and calm.
Nature (自然) science (科学): natural science.
Speed (速) per hour (時): kilometres per hour.
Children (子) and grandchildren (孫): descendants.
Dead (死) body (体): a corpse.
Writing (書き) underneath (下) the final one: a draft.
Real (実) learning (習): hands on practice, training.
Hold (執) the brush (筆): write a book or article.
Real (実) use (用): practical use.
Real (実) example (例): a real example.
Lose (失) love (恋): a broken heart.
Point (指) and fix (定): designate, like 指定席 reserved seat.
Private (私) iron (鉄) road: a private railway.
縛 has the thread radical (糸): tie up with rope.
Ground (地) base (盤): the ground under buildings.
Paper (紙) money (幣): bank notes.
萎 has the grass radical (艹): a plant wilts.
絞 has the thread radical (糸): twist and wring out a towel.
縞 has the thread radical (糸): woven threads make stripes.
Family name (氏) plus name (名): your full name.
Close (締め) and cut (切る) off: shut, close; 締め切り is a deadline.
Ground (地) surface (面): the ground.
Society (社会) science (科学): social science.
Snake (蛇) mouth (口): the tap, a snake head spitting water.
Weak (弱) point (点): a weakness.
Car (車) storehouse (庫): a garage.
Copy (写) life (生): sketch from real life.
Company's (社) opinion (説): a newspaper editorial.
Car (車) ring (輪): a wheel.
Gather (集) and meet (会): a meeting, assembly.
Live (住) plus reside (居): your home.
Gather (集) money (金): collect money.
Learn (習) characters (字): practice handwriting.
Repair (修) and mend (繕): fix something.
Heavy (重) point (点): the important point.
Take up (就) a duty (任): start a new post.
Around (周) the edges (辺): the surrounding area.
Heavy (重) role (役): an important role, a company director.
Heavy (重) amount (量): weight.
Heavy (重) power (力): gravity.
Ripe (熟) words (語): set phrases, kanji compounds.
Shrink (縮) small (小): reduce.
Main (主) word (語): the subject of a sentence.
Word that states (述) something: the predicate.
Long life (寿) plus life (命): life span.
Main (主) role (役): the lead part.
Follow (循) round a ring (環): circulation, a cycle.
Patrol (巡) and inspect (査): a police officer on patrol.
Order (順) repeated (々): one by one, in turn.
Order (順) plus sequence (序): the order of steps.
Pure (純) feelings (情): innocent, pure hearted.
Pure (純) plus pure essence (粋): completely pure, genuine.
諸 has words (言) for many things: various, like 諸国 various countries.
Make food vanish (消) and change (化): digestion.
Generals (将) on a game board (棋): Japanese chess.
Fixed (定) standard (規): a ruler for straight lines.
Upper (上) rank (級): advanced level.
Trade (商) business (業): commerce.
The fading (消) pole (極), opposite of 積極的: passive.
Prize (賞) money (金): prize money.
Small (小) number (数): a decimal less than one.
生 means be born: something is born, arises.
The point (点) where a lens can scorch (焦) paper: the focus.
Wipe out (消) poison (毒): disinfect.
Win (勝) or lose (敗): the result of a match.
Steam (蒸) goes off (発): evaporation, or a person vanishes.
Small (小) toilet business (便): urine.
Put out (消) and prevent (防) fires, office (署): fire station.
The true (正) content (味): net weight without the packaging.
Use up (消) and wear down (耗): exhaustion.
First (初) rank (級): beginner level.
Helper (助) professor (教授): assistant professor.
Eating (食) salt (塩): table salt.
First (初) ten days (旬) of the month.
Book (書) records (籍): books, publications.
Book (書) shop (店): a bookshop.
First (初) step (歩): the basics.
White (白) hair (髪), special reading しらが: grey hair.
Set up (立) privately (私): private school; trap, 市立 is also しりつ.
Grass (艹) with a heart (心) inside: the core or wick.
Truly (真) empty (空): a vacuum.
Heart (心) and body (身): mind and body.
信 means trust: an older form of 信じる, to believe.
Made (造) by people (人): man made.
Sleep (寝) stand (台): a bed, like a sleeper train berth.
Invade (侵) and enter (入): break in.
Human (人) culture (文) science (科学): the humanities.
Human (人) life (命): human life.
Many trees (森) plus woods (林): forest.
Parent's (親) kind (類): your relatives.
Compass needle (針) road (路): the course a ship takes.
God (神) story (話): a myth.
